Thanks Logan — appreciate the options. Quick update from our side: procurement has signed off on a baseline demo, but Security (Ben) and Platform (Calvin) want to be present. They asked for an expanded run-through that covers:

- security integration pattern (audit logs, KMS/HSM options)
- network architecture and VPC/on-prem deployment capabilities

Given the above they’re requesting a 75–90 minute session so we can deep-dive and leave time for questions. Also adding Nina from Procurement to the thread for travel/PO coordination.

- Mon 2027-10-18 15:00–16:30 ET

If you can accommodate a longer format and include someone from infra/architecture + security and our procurement contact, we’ll confirm.
